name: Navigations
purpose: The global and local navigation family: the web Masthead (logged out / logged in, with main-nav flyout, search flyout and user flyout), in-page Anchors, and the app-only Navigation bars (bottom tab bar and top bar). Lets users move around the site/app and access search and account.
$family: Covers the 'Navigations' canvas: Masthead ×2 + 3 flyouts, Anchors, Navigation bar bottom (app), Navigation bar top (app).

props.name: flyout
props.$note: Masthead flyouts: main nav (closed/scroll/open), search, user.

props.name: breakpoint
props.$note: Masthead/Anchors fully responsive; app nav bars are mobile.

variants.name: masthead
variants.use: Web global header. Logged-out & logged-in; opens a main-nav flyout (closed/scroll/open), a search flyout and a user flyout. Carries logo (color/primary), elevation/functional shadow.

variants.name: anchors
variants.use: In-page anchor navigation; active anchor marked by a brand-red underline indicator.

variants.name: nav-bar-bottom
variants.use: App-only bottom tab bar (.Nav Item × Nav Bar); icon + font-6 label.

variants.name: nav-bar-top
variants.use: App-only top bar (iOS Nav Bar Top); title + actions, active indicator.

tokens.masthead-surface: background/default (#fff) [bound via deprecated surface tokens — see tokenValidation]
tokens.text: text/default @ font-5 light/medium; nav labels font-5; tab labels font-6/7
tokens.divider/border: border/subtle, divider/border/subsection [bound via deprecated neutral-2/3 — see tokenValidation]
tokens.active-indicator (anchors/top-bar): brand red underline — bound to interactive (depricate)/on-light/border/brand-1/default (#db0011) → primary/border/default | color/primary
tokens.layout: layout/web/margin+gutter 16 (masthead) / 40 (search field grid), columns 12; padding/responsive + padding/fixed/large 20

accessibility.landmarks: Use <nav> landmarks with accessible names (primary, account, etc.); masthead logo links home
accessibility.flyout: Flyouts/menus must be keyboard-operable, trap focus while open, close on Esc, and expose aria-expanded on the trigger
accessibility.activeState: Active anchor/tab must not rely on the red underline colour alone (1.4.1) — expose aria-current
accessibility.search: Search field needs a label; results/overlay announced

antiPatterns: Marking the active nav/anchor with colour (red underline) only — pair with aria-current
Flyout/search overlay without focus trap or Esc dismissal
Leaving masthead/flyout/anchor surfaces & borders on the deprecated tokens — migrate (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS (values resolve) — but DEPRECATED-HEAVY: navigation is the least-migrated family so far. Standard rebinds are clean; two namespace flags below.

tokens.usedBy: masthead, main-nav flyout, search flyout, anchors, both app nav bars (row/surface)
Anchors + top nav bar active-indicator underline

blockersNoEquivalent.rebind: REVIEW — no live subtle-surface (Avatar/Headers/List gap family)

namespaceFlags: LIVE 'interactive/on-light/*' namespace seen on the SEARCH FLYOUT (interactive/on-light/surface/primary/default #fff, interactive/on-light/border/active/default #000, interactive/on-light/surface/brand-1/default #db0011 + /disabled #d7d8d6) — these are the un-suffixed mirror of the 'interactive (depricate)/on-light/*' tokens and look like the intended migration target, BUT they are ABSENT from the canonical variable export/store. Likely Sutherland-mode or an uncaptured collection. ACTION: confirm whether interactive/on-light/* is canon (then it's the bulk rebind target for the depricate interactive set) or Sutherland leakage. See [[sutherland-figma-mapping]].

Raw/legacy refs: bottom nav bar uses a non-tokenised shadow 'DAY/colour-level-shadow-1' (#0000001A, 0/2/6) instead of elevation/functional; colour/neutral/grey-1 primitive (bottom nav) is absent from the re-based store (primitive-name mismatch / leak).
